017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.net.*;
022import java.time.*;
023import java.util.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.http.remote.*;
026
027/**
028 * A fully-resolved, transport-layer HTTP request.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * All values (URIs, headers, bodies) are evaluated before this object is constructed — suppliers have been
032 * invoked, {@code null}-valued parts have been filtered, and the final URI has been assembled with query
033 * parameters and path substitutions applied.
034 *
035 * <p>
036 * Transport implementations receive a {@link TransportRequest} and are responsible for executing it against
037 * the remote server, returning a {@link TransportResponse}.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * <b>Beta — API subject to change.</b>
041 *
042 * @since 9.2.1
043 */
044public final class TransportRequest {
045
046   // Methods defined as idempotent by RFC 7231 §4.2.2 — replaying them cannot change server state beyond a
047   // single application of the request, so a transport may safely re-send them once on a fresh connection.
048   private static final Set<String> IDEMPOTENT_METHODS = Set.of("GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS", "TRACE");
049
050   private final String method;
051   private final URI uri;
052   private final List<TransportHeader> headers;
053   private final TransportBody body;
054   private final Duration timeout;
055   private final boolean policyEnforced;
056   private final boolean allowPrivateUrls;
057   private final RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges allowedAddressRanges;
058
059   private TransportRequest(Builder builder) {
060      this.method = reqnn("method", builder.method);
061      this.uri = reqnn("uri", builder.uri);
062      this.headers = List.copyOf(builder.headers);
063      this.body = builder.body;
064      this.timeout = builder.timeout;
065      this.policyEnforced = builder.policyEnforced;
066      this.allowPrivateUrls = builder.allowPrivateUrls;
067      this.allowedAddressRanges = builder.allowedAddressRanges;
068   }
069
070   /** Returns a new {@link Builder}. */
071   public static Builder builder() {
072      return new Builder();
073   }
074
075   /**
076    * Returns the HTTP method (e.g. {@code "GET"}, {@code "POST"}).
077    *
078    * @return The method. Never <jk>null</jk>.
079    */
080   public String getMethod() {
081      return method;
082   }
083
084   /**
085    * Returns the fully-resolved request URI, including query string.
086    *
087    * @return The URI. Never <jk>null</jk>.
088    */
089   public URI getUri() {
090      return uri;
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Returns all request headers in the order they should be sent.
095    *
096    * @return An unmodifiable list. Never <jk>null</jk>.
097    */
098   public List<TransportHeader> getHeaders() {
099      return headers;
100   }
101
102   /**
103    * Returns the first header with the given name (case-insensitive), or {@code null} if absent.
104    *
105    * @param name The header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
106    * @return The first matching header, or <jk>null</jk> if absent.
107    */
108   public TransportHeader getFirstHeader(String name) {
109      return headers.stream()
110         .filter(h -> eqic(h.name(), name))
111         .findFirst()
112         .orElse(null);
113   }
114
115   /**
116    * Returns the request body, or {@code null} if this is a body-less request (e.g. GET, HEAD).
117    *
118    * @return The body, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
119    */
120   public TransportBody getBody() {
121      return body;
122   }
123
124   /**
125    * Returns {@code true} if this request can be transparently re-sent once after a stale-connection failure.
126    *
127    * <p>
128    * A pooled keep-alive socket can be torn down by the server between requests; when a transport then reuses
129    * that socket the first write fails before any response is received (e.g. an early {@code EOF} or a
130    * {@code NoHttpResponseException}).  Such a failure is safe to retry on a fresh connection <b>only</b> when
131    * replaying the request cannot cause a duplicate side effect, which requires both of:
132    * <ul>
133    *    <li>an <a class="doclink" href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7231#section-4.2.2">idempotent</a>
134    *       HTTP method ({@code GET}, {@code HEAD}, {@code PUT}, {@code DELETE}, {@code OPTIONS}, {@code TRACE}) — never
135    *       {@code POST} or any other non-idempotent method, and
136    *    <li>a body that is either absent or {@link TransportBody#isRepeatable() repeatable}, so the exact same bytes
137    *       can be written again.
138    * </ul>
139    *
140    * <p>
141    * When in doubt this returns {@code false} — the caller must fail closed rather than risk double-executing a
142    * request.
143    *
144    * @return {@code true} if the request is provably safe to replay once.
145    */
146   public boolean isSafeToReplay() {
147      return IDEMPOTENT_METHODS.contains(method.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) && (body == null || body.isRepeatable());
148   }
149
150   /**
151    * Returns the per-call response timeout, or {@code null} if none was set.
152    *
153    * <p>
154    * A {@code null} value means the transport's own default applies.  Connect timeouts remain a client-level
155    * concern.  All built-in transports honor this value (JDK, Apache HttpClient 4.5/5, OkHttp, Jetty and the mock transport).
156    *
157    * @return The response timeout, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
158    */
159   public Duration getTimeout() {
160      return timeout;
161   }
162
163   /**
164    * Returns {@code true} if this request originated from a {@code @Remote}/{@code @Url} call and is subject to
165    * the SSRF guardrail (see {@code org.apache.juneau.http.remote.RemoteUrlPolicy}).
166    *
167    * <p>
168    * Ordinary (non-{@code @Remote}) requests built directly via {@code RestClient.get(url)} etc. are never
169    * policy-covered.
170    *
171    * @return {@code true} if the SSRF guardrail applies to this request.
172    */
173   public boolean isPolicyEnforced() {
174      return policyEnforced;
175   }
176
177   /**
178    * Returns {@code true} if the {@code allowPrivateUrls} opt-in is in effect for this request, disabling the
179    * deny-private / pin-on-connect / redirect-revalidation checks (the {@code http}/{@code https} scheme
180    * requirement still applies upstream).
181    *
182    * @return {@code true} if private/loopback/link-local/metadata targets are allowed for this request.
183    */
184   public boolean isAllowPrivateUrls() {
185      return allowPrivateUrls;
186   }
187
188   /**
189    * Returns the per-client special-purpose address ranges that the SSRF guardrail re-permits for this request (see
190    * {@link RestClient.Builder#allowAddressRanges(String...)}); they are unioned with the
191    * {@value RemoteUrlPolicy#ALLOW_ADDRESS_RANGES_PROPERTY} system property.
192    *
193    * @return The allowed ranges. Never <jk>null</jk>; {@link org.apache.juneau.http.remote.RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges#NONE RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges#NONE} by default.
194    */
195   public RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges getAllowedAddressRanges() {
196      return allowedAddressRanges;
197   }
198
199   /**
200    * Returns {@code true} if the SSRF guardrail's connect-time machinery (pin-on-connect + Juneau-controlled
201    * redirect revalidation) must be applied by the transport for this request: {@link #isPolicyEnforced()} is set
202    * and {@link #isAllowPrivateUrls()} is not.
203    *
204    * @return {@code true} if the transport must pin-on-connect and manually revalidate redirects for this request.
205    */
206   public boolean isSsrfGuardActive() {
207      return policyEnforced && ! allowPrivateUrls;
208   }
209
210   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
211   // Builder
212   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
213
214   /**
215    * Fluent builder for {@link TransportRequest}.
216    *
217    * <p>
218    * <b>Beta — API subject to change.</b>
219    *
220    * @since 9.2.1
221    */
222   public static final class Builder {
223
224      String method;
225      URI uri;
226      final List<TransportHeader> headers = l();
227      TransportBody body;
228      Duration timeout;
229      boolean policyEnforced;
230      boolean allowPrivateUrls;
231      RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges allowedAddressRanges = RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges.NONE;
232
233      private Builder() {}
234
235      /**
236       * Sets the HTTP method.
237       *
238       * @param value The method (e.g. {@code "GET"}). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
239       * @return This object.
240       */
241      public Builder method(String value) {
242         method = value;
243         return this;
244      }
245
246      /**
247       * Sets the request URI.
248       *
249       * @param value The URI. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
250       * @return This object.
251       */
252      public Builder uri(URI value) {
253         uri = value;
254         return this;
255      }
256
257      /**
258       * Sets the request URI from a string.
259       *
260       * @param value The URI string. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
261       * @return This object.
262       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the string is not a valid URI.
263       */
264      public Builder uri(String value) {
265         try {
266            uri = new URI(value);
267         } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
268            throw iaex(e, "Invalid URI: %s", value);
269         }
270         return this;
271      }
272
273      /**
274       * Appends a request header.
275       *
276       * @param name The header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
277       * @param value The header value. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
278       * @return This object.
279       */
280      public Builder header(String name, String value) {
281         headers.add(TransportHeader.of(name, value));
282         return this;
283      }
284
285      /**
286       * Appends multiple request headers.
287       *
288       * @param value The headers to add. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
289       * @return This object.
290       */
291      public Builder headers(Collection<TransportHeader> value) {
292         headers.addAll(value);
293         return this;
294      }
295
296      /**
297       * Sets the request body.
298       *
299       * @param value The body. May be <jk>null</jk> for body-less requests.
300       * @return This object.
301       */
302      public Builder body(TransportBody value) {
303         body = value;
304         return this;
305      }
306
307      /**
308       * Sets the per-call response timeout.
309       *
310       * @param value The response timeout. May be <jk>null</jk> to use the transport default.  Must otherwise be positive.
311       * @return This object.
312       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If <c>value</c> is zero or negative.
313       */
314      public Builder timeout(Duration value) {
315         if (value != null && (value.isZero() || value.isNegative()))
316            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Request timeout must be positive: " + value);
317         timeout = value;
318         return this;
319      }
320
321      /**
322       * Marks this request as originating from a {@code @Remote}/{@code @Url} call, subject to the SSRF guardrail,
323       * and records whether the {@code allowPrivateUrls} opt-in is in effect.
324       *
325       * @param policyEnforced {@code true} if this request is policy-covered.
326       * @param allowPrivateUrls {@code true} if the {@code allowPrivateUrls} opt-in disables the deny-private checks.
327       * @return This object.
328       */
329      public Builder remoteUrlPolicy(boolean policyEnforced, boolean allowPrivateUrls) {
330         this.policyEnforced = policyEnforced;
331         this.allowPrivateUrls = allowPrivateUrls;
332         return this;
333      }
334
335      /**
336       * Sets the per-client special-purpose address ranges the SSRF guardrail re-permits for this request.
337       *
338       * @param value The allowed ranges. <jk>null</jk> means none.
339       * @return This object.
340       */
341      public Builder allowedAddressRanges(RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges value) {
342         this.allowedAddressRanges = value == null ? RemoteUrlPolicy.AllowedRanges.NONE : value;
343         return this;
344      }
345
346      /**
347       * Builds and returns the {@link TransportRequest}.
348       *
349       * @return A new instance. Never <jk>null</jk>.
350       */
351      public TransportRequest build() {
352         return new TransportRequest(this);
353      }
354   }
355}
